gameSubtitle: A poker run built with tiles
gameTermChipsBody: The base material for score calculation, set by hand type and chip bonuses. Chips are not held or spent like gold.
gameTermGoldBody: Currency used in the market to buy Jesters and Items or reroll offers.
gameTermScoreMultiplierBody: A stronger multiplier applied at the end. Score x2 really doubles the score.
gameTermScorePercentBody: Raises this confirm score by a percentage after chips are counted. Score +20% makes the final score 1.2x.
homeArchiveDescription: Review reward cards, Jesters, and Items
homeContinueSectionEmpty: There is no saved run to continue.
homeOtherMenuSectionSubtitle: Review collected rewards and unlocked entries.
homeRunInfoEmptyDescription: Growth info appears after starting a new run.
homeRunInfoReadyDescription: Check hand growth and added deck tiles for the current run
reduceMotionActive: Reduce Motion is on for this device, so shake and bounce effects are off.
runInfoActionSubtitle: View hand levels and chip growth for this run.
runInfoTileChipDescription: Shown by tile number, regardless of color. The current confirm score is calculated from the hand base chips.
tutorialBattleActionsDesc: Confirm, clear, move, and discard only when they help build lines.
tutorialBattleBoardDesc: Place hand tiles into empty cells to build rows, columns, and diagonals.
tutorialBattleHandDesc: Choose a hand tile and draw new tiles when you need more options.
tutorialBattlePreviewDesc: Check which lines and score changes your current choice can confirm.
tutorialMarketDetailDesc: Read the selected offer, then buy or sell from the action panel.
tutorialMarketOffersDesc: Select offers shown in the current tab and offer type to inspect them.
tutorialMarketReplaySubtitle: Show shop owned areas, offers, and reroll controls again.
tutorialMarketRerollDesc: Page or reroll offers for the current tab and offer type.
tutorialMarketSlotsDesc: Check owned Jesters, Slots, Tools, and Gear for the current tab.
